issues.description: A version cap is treated as a fix; no precondition for its removal is stated.
issues.detail: TESTED-NOT-PROVED. The diff pins setuptools<82 in three places to mask upstream removal of pkg_resources. There is no specification of the postcondition under which the cap may be lifted, no invariant tying the three pins together, and no termination function ("when is this FIXME done?"). The cap will rot silently.

issues.description: Runtime dependency added to library to satisfy a CI build constraint.
issues.detail: The setuptools<82 pin is correctly scoped to CI in env_setup.sh and setup_mmcv.sh, but core/setup.py propagates the same cap to every downstream installer of autogluon. The precondition ("mmcv build needs old setuptools") does not hold for users who never build mmcv. Frame violation: CI hygiene leaking into the public package.

issues.description: Silent version drift: mmdet 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0 with no stated justification.
issues.detail: The control flow of the change is mostly about setuptools, but mmdet is simultaneously bumped a minor version. No precondition, no reasoning for why 3.3.0 is required (vs. retaining 3.2.0), no test evidence cited. A reader cannot tell whether this is necessary or incidental scope creep smuggled into a CI fix.

Passing --no-build-isolation to mmcv install means the build now depends on the ambient setuptools pinned two lines earlier. This is an implicit invariant ("the outer setuptools<82 must be installed first, in this interpreter, before mmcv"). The invariant is unstated and brittle if steps are reordered.

issues.description: Three independent setuptools<82 pins with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: env_setup.sh, setup_mmcv.sh, and core/setup.py each carry the same constraint. When the upstream issue is fixed, the operator must remember all three sites. The FIXME comment exists in two of three locations, not all. Duplication of a constraint without a shared definition is a structured-programming failure.

review.summary: This patch is a pragmatic CI unblock, not a reasoned fix. It pins setuptools<82 in three locations to work around upstream mmcv breakage, with no specification of when the pin may be removed and no invariant linking the three sites. The leakage of a CI build constraint into core/setup.py is the most consequential issue: it imposes the workaround on every downstream user of autogluon, not just the CI builder of mmcv. A silent mmdet 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0 bump rides along without justification. TESTED-NOT-PROVED, accepted under operational pressure; the FIXME debt must be tracked and the runtime-vs-CI frame violation corrected.
